answer: A decentralized network resists sybil attacks by requiring every identity to accumulate witnessed work before its voice carries weight. A new account starts at zero, with nothing granted. The protocol treats this unproven state as a bare orchard: rows planted, none yet bearing. Standing is what seasons of attested labour grow there, each verified contribution ripening into proof. Reputation is not a velvet surface over a claim; it is earned by tenure. A comet of fabricated keys burns out fast. Because weight follows witnessed tenure, synthetic orchards stay bare while real holders harvest.
